description_en: Queries virus files detected under the current Alibaba Cloud account and their disposition status with paging. Supports filtering by virus type, risk level, user terminal device, user, and discovery time
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下检出的病毒文件及其处置状态，支持按病毒类型、风险等级、用户终端设备、用户与发现时间筛选
name: ListVirusFileStatuses

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters by virus type. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by virus type is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按病毒类型过滤，不允许重复。不传则不按病毒类型过滤
parameters.name: virus_types

parameters.help_en: Filters by risk level. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by risk level is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按风险等级过滤，不允许重复。不传则不按风险等级过滤
parameters.name: risk_levels

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virus scan task that detected the virus file. This parameter is used to filter detection results of a specified task. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListVirusScanTasks](~~ListVirusScanTasks~~): Lists virus scan tasks.
[CreateVirusScanTask](~~CreateVirusScanTask~~): Creates a virus scan task
parameters.help_zh:
检出该病毒文件的病毒扫描任务ID，用于筛选指定任务的检出结果。取值来源：
[ListVirusScanTasks](~~ListVirusScanTasks~~)：批量查询病毒扫描任务。
[CreateVirusScanTask](~~CreateVirusScanTask~~)：创建病毒扫描任务
parameters.name: scan_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The user ID. Exact match. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user terminal devices.
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries user terminal device details
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，精确匹配。长度不超过128个字符。取值来源：
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备。
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情
parameters.name: sase_user_id

parameters.help_en: The username. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), asterisks (*), hyphens (-), at signs (@), spaces, middle dots (·), and parentheses
parameters.help_zh: 用户名，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、星号（*）、连字符（-）、@、空格、中间点（·）、圆括号
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type of the user terminal device. Valid values:
windows: Windows.
macOS: macOS
parameters.help_zh:
用户终端设备的操作系统类型。取值：
windows：Windows系统。
macOS：macOS系统
parameters.name: dev_type

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the user terminal device. Exact match. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user terminal devices
parameters.help_zh:
用户终端设备的唯一标识，精确匹配。长度不超过64个字符。取值来源：
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备
parameters.name: dev_tag

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the user terminal device. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户终端设备的主机名，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: hostname

parameters.help_en: The department name. Matches any level of the organizational structure to which the user belongs. Specify the department name itself without the full path of the organizational structure. The value can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), commas (,), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 部门名称，匹配用户所属组织架构中的任一层级部门。填写部门名称本身，不需要填写组织架构的完整路径。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及空格、半角句点（.）、逗号（,）、分号（;）、正斜杠（/）、@、连字符（-）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: department

parameters.help_en:
Filters by disposition status. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by disposition status is applied. Valid values:
Pending: Pending disposition.
Processed: Disposed
parameters.help_zh:
按处置状态过滤。不传则不按处置状态过滤。取值：
Pending：待处置。
Processed：已处置
parameters.name: file_process_status

parameters.help_en: Filters by disposition action. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by disposition action is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按处置动作过滤，不允许重复。不传则不按处置动作过滤
parameters.name: operations

parameters.help_en: The start time for filtering by virus file discovery time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter must be specified together with EndTime and must be earlier than EndTime
parameters.help_zh: 病毒文件发现时间的筛选起点，秒级Unix时间戳。必须与EndTime同时传入，且小于EndTime
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for filtering by virus file discovery time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter must be specified together with StartTime and must be later than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 病毒文件发现时间的筛选终点，秒级Unix时间戳。必须与StartTime同时传入，且大于StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The MD5 value of the virus file. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 病毒文件的MD5值，支持模糊查询。长度不超过64个字符
parameters.name: file_md5
